en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an old street scene with historic buildings. The central structure has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, small irregular windows with decorative frames, and an ornate entrance with a religious niche or relief above the doorway. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand near the entrance. On the left is a tall ornamental column or fountain in a cobbled square. Printed captions in red at the top and bottom identify the location and the publisher.
